verdict.rationale: A dashboard-embedded AI assistant is a plausible feature for a SaaS auth platform, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no built-in assistant. Clerk offers a remote MCP server for external agents like Claude, Cursor, and Copilot, CLI hookups for those agents, docs for Codex and Claude Code, and 'eve' building blocks for authorizing agent tool calls. All of these are external-agent integrations or developer primitives, not an in-product assistant users can delegate tasks to.
